spatial_policy: one fixed H,W per video for all FPS, models and orders; multiples of 32; aspect-ratio error first, then area error
temporal_policy: GT-blind nearest measured PTS to k/fps starting at zero, ties earlier; deduplicate; full duration; no 768 frame cap; duplicate final frame only for temporal patch packing
resize: torchvision bicubic antialias uint8, directly from source RGB
